{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gallery of Ancestors''' was a sacred site on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] that contained the vaults of deceased [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. Inside was the [[Catacomb of Eminents]] where the vaults of eminent Sullustans were located, including that of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Supreme Commander]] [[Sien Sovv]]. After Sovv's [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] in [[36 ABY]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] sponsored a funerary feast here which was unrivaled in the history of the planet.
